values: A coefficient normalization for positive definite forms — Alec Kriebel, v1.0. Preprint date: 2026-09-23; published on Zenodo: 2026-09-26. Equality in the Fradelizi–Paouris–Schütt second-moment inequality — Alec Kriebel, v1.0.0. Preprint date: 2026-09-23; published on Zenodo: 2026-09-26. Affirmative resolution of OWR-4136-011: equality holds exactly for nondegenerate simplices with every vertex of norm r, for all n≥1. Four-page unrefereed, AI-assisted preprint; two fresh sequential adversarial reviews found no actionable issues. Includes exact verifier (298 checks, 18 cases), source comparison, and bounded priority audit. Public record: https://zenodo.org/records/22983138 ; paper and materials: https://aleckriebel.github.io/Math/papers/fps-equality/

The odd-part ratio under slow variation: a note on the printed Hilberdink problem — Alec Kriebel, v1.0.1. Preprint date: 2026-09-23; published on Zenodo: 2026-09-26. Resolves the printed slow-variation existence question, with limit 1/sum(k>=0) f(2^k), taking 1/infinity=0. The possible intended index-one formulation is not resolved; originality is not certified. Unrefereed; final independent AI adversarial review found no actionable issues. Includes exact finite-check code, source and priority audits. Paper and materials: https://aleckriebel.github.io/Math/papers/odd-part-slow-variation/

A note on Γ-supercyclicity of dissipative composition operators — Alec Kriebel; v1.0.1 (2026-09-23); deposited 2026-09-26. Affirmative answer for every Γ in the original separable Lp setting. Attributed application of Abbar (2019) and Abbar–Kuznetsova (2020/2021); unrefereed note. https://aleckriebel.github.io/Math/papers/gamma-supercyclicity/

Radial orthogonality does not imply dual 1-conformal flatness — Alec Kriebel, v1.0.1. Preprint date and Zenodo publication: 2026-09-26. Explicit negative answer to Kurose’s printed Question 3(e): S²(1) × R with its Levi–Civita connection has integrable radial distributions but its dual is nowhere locally 1-conformally flat. Includes a non-self-dual example and n≥3 extension. Four-page unrefereed, AI-assisted preprint; two fresh adversarial AI reviews found no actionable issues. Exact and 403-check symbolic verifiers included. Historical priority unresolved; no first-resolution claim. Paper and materials: https://aleckriebel.github.io/Math/papers/radial-statistical-counterexample/

Nonattainment in the Harrell–Stubbe Dirichlet gap inequality — Alec Kriebel, v1.0.1. Preprint date: 2026-09-23; published on Zenodo: 2026-09-26. Negative resolution of the corrected saturation question: the Dirichlet gap bound is strict at every finite index on every nonempty bounded open Euclidean set. Three-page AI-assisted, unrefereed preprint; two fresh adversarial reviews found no actionable issues. Includes source/priority audits and a verifier with 7,016 exact checks. Public record: https://zenodo.org/records/22983513 ; paper and materials: https://aleckriebel.github.io/Math/papers/strict-dirichlet-gap/
